Record shows that in respect of an incident which is alleged to have occurred on 13.03.2023, a delayed first information report dated 14.03.2023 was lodged by the first informant, namely,
Vijender Singh (Phoofa of the prosecutrix) and was registered as Case Crime No.0045 of 2023,
under Section 363 IPC, police station Hafizpur, district Hapur.
sentences._hearing_file: Vipin vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 16 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: In the aforesaid first information report, one unknown person has been arraigned as solitary accused.
sentences._hearing_file: Vipin vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 16 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: The gravamen of the allegations made in the FIR is to the effect that the daughter of brother-in-law of first informant i.e. prosecutrix, namely, X aged about 13 years has gone missing since 13.03.2023 at 8.00 A.M.
sentences._hearing_file: Vipin vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 16 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: After aforementioned FIR was lodged, Investigating Officer proceeded with statutory investigation of concerned Case Crime Number in terms of Chapter XII CrPC.
sentences._hearing_file: Vipin vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 16 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: The prosecutrix was recovered on 26.03.2023.
sentences._hearing_file: Vipin vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 16 December, 2023.json

sentences.text:
The statement of the prosecutrix was recorded under Section 161 CrPC,
which is on record at page 25 of the paper book.
sentences._hearing_file: Vipin vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 16 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: The prosecutrix in her aforesaid statement has not supported the FIR.
sentences._hearing_file: Vipin vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 16 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: To the contrary, the prosecutrix has stated that she came and joined the applicant herself and thereafter accompanied him to Rudrapur.
sentences._hearing_file: Vipin vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 16 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: The prosecutrix has further stated that physical relations were also maintained between the parties upon consent of the prosecutrix.
sentences._hearing_file: Vipin vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 16 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: Thereafter, the prosecutrix was requested for her internal medical examination, which was refused by her.
sentences._hearing_file: Vipin vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 16 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: Ultimately, the statement of the prosecutrix was recorded under Section 164 CrPC, which is on record at page 27 of the paper book, wherein she has rejoined and re-affirmed her previous statement recorded under Section 161 CrPC.
sentences._hearing_file: Vipin vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 16 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: During course of investigation, Investigating Officer examined the Principal, Sarvodaya Inter College, Banboi, Bulandshahar where the prosecutrix was studying in Class-IX.
sentences._hearing_file: Vipin vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 16 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: As per the school record, the date of birth of the prosecutrix recorded therein is 08.04.2010.
sentences._hearing_file: Vipin vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 16 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: Investigating Officer further examined the first informant and other witnesses under Section 161 CrPC.
sentences._hearing_file: Vipin vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 16 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: The witnesses so examined have supported the FIR.
sentences._hearing_file: Vipin vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 16 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: On the basis of above and other material collected by the Investigating Officer during the course of investigation, he came to the conclusion that since the prosecutrix is below 18 years of age therefore offence complained of against the applicant is fully established in the crime in question.
sentences._hearing_file: Vipin vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 16 December, 2023.json

sentences.text:
Accordingly, he submitted the charge-sheet dated 12.04.2023,
whereby applicant has been charge-sheeted under Sections 363, 376 (3) IPC and Section 3/4 (2)
Pocso Act.
sentences._hearing_file: Vipin vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 16 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant contends that though applicant is not named in the FIR but a charge-sheeted accused, yet he is liable to be enlarged on bail.
sentences._hearing_file: Vipin vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 16 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: Referring to the statements of the prosecutrix recorded under Section 161/164 CrPC, he submits that the prosecutrix is a willing and consenting party.
sentences._hearing_file: Vipin vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 16 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: There is no medical evidence to support the charge-sheet.
sentences._hearing_file: Vipin vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 16 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: In view of above, it cannot be said that the applicant has deliberately and forcibly dislodged the modesty of the prosecutrix.
sentences._hearing_file: Vipin vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 16 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: On the above premise, he therefore submits that applicant is liable to be enlarged on bail.
sentences._hearing_file: Vipin vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 16 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: Even otherwise, applicant is a man of clean antecedents having no criminal history to his credit except the present one.

sentences.text: As such, he has undergone more than eight months of incarceration.
sentences._hearing_file: Vipin vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 16 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: The police report under Section 173 (2) CrPC has already been submitted.
sentences._hearing_file: Vipin vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 16 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: As such, the entire evidence sought to be relied upon by the prosecution against the applicant stands crystalized.
sentences._hearing_file: Vipin vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 16 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: However, up to this stage, no such circumstance has emerged necessitating the custodial arrest of applicant during the pendency of trial.
sentences._hearing_file: Vipin vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 16 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: It is thus urged that applicant is liable to be enlarged on bail.
sentences._hearing_file: Vipin vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 16 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: In case the applicant is enlarged on bail, he shall not misuse the liberty of bail and shall co-operate with the trial.
sentences._hearing_file: Vipin vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 16 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: Per contra, the learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail.
sentences._hearing_file: Vipin vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 16 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: He submits that since applicant is a charge-sheeted accused therefore, he does not deserve any indulgence by this Court.
sentences._hearing_file: Vipin vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 16 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: Attention of the Court was invited to the affidavit of the Investigating Officer dated 22.11.2023 and on basis thereof the learned A.G.A. contends that the date of birth of the prosecutrix recorded in the institution first attended by her is 14.08.2008.
sentences._hearing_file: Vipin vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 16 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: The occurrence giving rise to the present criminal proceedings is alleged to have occurred on 13.03.2023.
sentences._hearing_file: Vipin vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 16 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: As such, the prosecutrix was aged about 14 years 06 months and 29 days on the date of occurrence therefore she was below 16 years of age.
sentences._hearing_file: Vipin vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 16 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: In view of above, the consent, if any, of the prosecutrix is wholly immaterial.
sentences._hearing_file: Vipin vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 16 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: To buttress his submission, the learned A.G.A. has referred to the judgement of the Supreme Court in X (Minor) Vs. State of Jharkhand 2022 Livelaw (SC) 194 and on basis thereof he contends that no sympathy be shown by this court in favour of applicant.

sentences.text: As such, the present application for bail is liable to be rejected.
sentences._hearing_file: Vipin vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 16 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: When confronted with above, the learned counsel for applicant could not overcome the same.
sentences._hearing_file: Vipin vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 16 December, 2023.json

sentences.text:
Having heard the learned counsel for applicant, the learned A.G.A. for State, upon perusal of material brought on record, nature and gravity of offence, evidence, complicity of the accused,
accusation made, coupled with the fact that the objections raised by the learned A.G.A. in opposition to the present application for bail could not be dislodged by the learned counsel for applicant with reference to the record therefore, irrespective of the varied submissions urged by the learned counsel for applicant in support of the present application for bail, this Court does not find any good or sufficient ground to enlarge the applicant on bail.
sentences._hearing_file: Vipin vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 16 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: As a result, this application for bail thus fails and is liable to be rejected.
sentences._hearing_file: Vipin vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 16 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: It is accordingly rejected.

1 (2) Pocso Act, police station Hafizpur, district Hapur, during the pendency of trial.
By virtue of the provisions contained in Section 94 of The Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015, the age of the prosecutrix could have been determined only with reference to the date of birth mentioned in any of the documents mentioned in Section 94 (2)(i) and 94 (2)(ii) of Act, 2015.
Similar view has been taken by the Supreme Court in P. Yuvprakash Vs. State Represented by Inspector of Police 2023 SCC Online (SC) 846.
opennyai_summary.final__ANALYSIS:
The material so collected by the Investigating Officer upon further investigation has been brought on record by the learned A.G.A. by means of an affidavit of the Investigating Officer dated 22.11.2023 along with the supplementary case-diary of concerned case crime number which is already on record.

Pocso Act.
In view of above, it cannot be said that the applicant has deliberately and forcibly dislodged the modesty of the prosecutrix.
Even otherwise, applicant is a man of clean antecedents having no criminal history to his credit except the present one.
The applicant is in custody since 26.03.2023.
As such, he has undergone more than eight months of incarceration.
As such, the entire evidence sought to be relied upon by the prosecution against the applicant stands crystalized.
In case the applicant is enlarged on bail, he shall not misuse the liberty of bail and shall co-operate with the trial.
opennyai_summary.final__arguments:
To buttress his submission, the learned A.G.A. has referred to the judgement of the Supreme Court in X (Minor) Vs. State of Jharkhand 2022 Livelaw (SC) 194 and on basis thereof he contends that no sympathy be shown by this court in favour of applicant.
As such, the present application for bail is liable to be rejected.
Having heard the learned counsel for applicant, the learned A.G.A. for State, upon perusal of material brought on record, nature and gravity of offence, evidence, complicity of the accused,
accusation made, coupled with the fact that the objections raised by the learned A.G.A. in opposition to the present application for bail could not be dislodged by the learned counsel for applicant with reference to the record therefore, irrespective of the varied submissions urged by the learned counsel for applicant in support of the present application for bail, this Court does not find any good or sufficient ground to enlarge the applicant on bail.
